senses.gloss:
क्षु KṢU, Ⅱ. P. kṣau-ti, sneeze: pp. 🞄kṣuta, having sneezed;
 n. sneeze. ava, 🞄pp. sneezed upon.
क्षु kṣú, n. [gh(a)s-ú] food, nutriment.
क्षुण्ण kṣuṇ-ṇa, pp. √ kṣud.
क्षुत् kṣú-t, f. sneezing.

क्षुत्क्षाम kṣut-kṣāma, a. emaciated with 🞄hunger: -kaṇṭha, a. hvg. a throat —;
 pipāsita, pp. tormented with hunger and thirst.
क्षुध् KṢUDH, Ⅳ. P. kṣúdhya, be 🞄hungry: pp. kṣudhita, hungry.
क्षुध् kṣúdh, f. hunger.

क्षुधा kṣudh-ā, f. id.: -kara, a. causing 🞄hunger;
 -ārta, pp. tortured with hunger.
क्षुधालु kṣudhā-lu, a. hungry.

क्षुन्निरोध kṣun-nirodha, m. suppression of 🞄hunger, starvation;
 -mat, a. hungry.

क्षुप kṣupa, m. ā, f. shrub, bush;
 a-ka, m., 🞄a-kā, f. id..
क्षुब्ध kṣub-dha, pp. √ kṣubu: -tā, f. commotion.

क्षुमत् kṣu-mát, a. nutritious;
 strong, vigorous.
क्षुरिका kṣur-ikā, f. knife, dagger.
क्षुल्ल kṣulla, ˚क -ká, a. small, little, tiny.
